```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "TransferSemi", "DESCRIPTION")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(current, "visualization_github"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Cannot locate the repository root.", call. = FALSE)
}
repo_root <- find_repo_root()
derived_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "outputs", "derived", "MSE_visualization")
figure_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "outputs", "figures", "MSE_visualization")
dir.create(derived_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
visualization_data_file <- file.path(
  repo_root,
  "semi-transfer-learning",
  "MSE_visualization_data.rds"
)
cate_combined_file <- file.path(derived_dir, "CATE_final_combined_results.RData")
dr_combined_file <- file.path(derived_dir, "DR_final_combined_results.RData")

if (!file.exists(visualization_data_file)) {
  stop(
    "The precomputed visualization data file is missing: ",
    visualization_data_file,
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

visualization_data <- readRDS(visualization_data_file)
required_components <- c("plm", "cate", "dr")
missing_components <- setdiff(required_components, names(visualization_data))
if (!is.list(visualization_data) || length(missing_components) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "MSE_visualization_data.rds must be a named list containing: ",
    paste(required_components, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

plm_results <- as.data.frame(visualization_data$plm)
cate_results <- as.data.frame(visualization_data$cate)
dr_results <- as.data.frame(visualization_data$dr)

required_columns <- list(
  plm = c("method", "seed", "n", "similarity", "mean_value", "max_value", paste0("task", 1:5)),
  cate = c("Method", "seed", "n", "similarity", paste0("Task", 1:5)),
  dr = c("Method", "seed", "n", "similarity", paste0("Task", 1:5))
)
for (component in required_components) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns[[component]],
    names(visualization_data[[component]])
  )
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      component,
      " data are missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

"Late Fusion" = "#7CFC00",          # bright lawn green

)
```

# Data Preprocess

This notebook reads the supplied precomputed data in
`semi-transfer-learning/MSE_visualization_data.rds`. Re-running the simulation
jobs is not required to render the figures below.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
all_combined <- plm_results
plm_setting_files <- character()

for (sample_n in c(100, 200)) {
  for (similarity_value in similarity_list) {
    output_file <- file.path(
      derived_dir,
      sprintf("mse_n_%d_simi_%.2f.RData", sample_n, similarity_value)
    )
    output <- plm_results %>%
      filter(
        .data$n == .env$sample_n,
        near(.data$similarity, .env$similarity_value)
      ) %>%
      arrange(.data$method, .data$seed)
    if (nrow(output) == 0L) {
      stop(
        "No saved PLM results for n = ",
        sample_n,
        ", similarity = ",
        similarity_value,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    save(output, file = output_file)
    plm_setting_files <- c(plm_setting_files, output_file)
  }
}

```

# Start Visuallization

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
files <- plm_setting_files
for (file in files) {
  cat("Loaded:", file, "\n")
}

files

prepare_data <- function(result, file_name) {
  # Define methods to analyze
  methods <- c("Baseline", "Sai_Transfer", "Para_Transfer_Tuned", "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned", "Net_Transfer", "ARMUL_transfer", "pERM_Transfer", "Pooled")

  # Generate quantile data for each method
  quantiles_list <- lapply(methods, function(m) {
    # 1 meas max and 2 means mean
    quantile_df <- apply(result[result$method == m, "mean_value", drop = FALSE], 2, function(col) {
      quantile(col, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
    })
    colnames(quantile_df) <- m
    quantile_df
  })

  # Combine quantile data and reshape it to long format
  quantiles <- do.call(cbind, quantiles_list)
  quantiles_long <- melt(quantiles, variable.name = "Method", value.name = "Value")
  
  # Add a column with the file name for faceting
  quantiles_long$Dataset <- basename(file_name)
  
  return(quantiles_long)
}




load(files[1])
all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(file) {
  result <- load(file)
  result <- get(result)
  prepare_data(result, file)
}))
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract 'n' (e.g., 200 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    n = as.numeric(gsub(".*_n_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", Dataset)),
    
    # Extract 'similarity' (e.g., 0.4 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    similarity = as.numeric(gsub(".*_simi_(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?).*", "\\1", Dataset))
  )
all_data <- all_data %>%
  rename(Method = Var2) |> filter(n!=500)


custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),  # Format 'n' as "n = ..."
  similarity = function(value) paste0("" ,value)  # Format 'similarity' as "similarity = ..."
)

# Plot with customized facet labels
plot <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2 , width = box_width) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +  # Apply custom labeller
  labs(
    x = "Method", y = "Mean MSE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),  # Center the title
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6, angle = 20)
  ) #+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange", "darkgreen"))
library(stringr)

all_data_1 = all_data
all_data <- all_data_1 %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(Method, "Net_Transfer") ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL_transfer") ~ "ARMUL",
    str_detect(Method, "pERM_Transfer") ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
    

  ))
all_data$Method <- factor(all_data$Method,
  levels = c(
    "Baseline",
    "Data Pooling",                 # Pooling
    "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    "pERM",
    "Representation Transfer",     # Representation Learning
    "ARMUL",
    "Late Fusion",
    "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
  )
)

#method_order <- all_data %>%
#  group_by(Method) %>%
#  summarise(med_value = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
#  arrange(desc(med_value)) %>%
#  pull(Method)
all_data$Method <- factor(all_data$Method, levels = method_order)
PLM_MSE <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2, width = box_width) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Mean MSE") +
  theme_minimal() +

    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1e-5, NA))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors)
PLM_MSE
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)

# Load the processed data
load(cate_combined_file)

# If method names are stored as row names, convert them to a "Method" column.
if (!"Method" %in% colnames(final_combined)) {
  final_combined <- rownames_to_column(final_combined, var = "Method")
}
patterns <- c("Para_Transfer_Tuned", "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned", "Baseline",
              "Sai_Transfer", "Net_Transfer", "ARMUL_transfer", 
              "pERM_transfer", "Pooled")

final_combined <- final_combined[
  Reduce(`|`, lapply(patterns, function(p) grepl(p, final_combined$Method))),
]
# Recode method names so that variants are combined.
final_combined <- final_combined %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    grepl("^Baseline", Method) ~ "Baseline",
    grepl("^Sai_Transfer", Method) ~ "Sai_Transfer",
    grepl("^Para_Transfer", Method) ~ "Para_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^NonPara_Transfer", Method) ~ "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^Net_Transfer", Method) ~ "Net_Transfer",
    grepl("^ARMUL_transfer", Method) ~ "ARMUL_transfer",
    grepl("^pERM_transfer", Method) ~ "pERM_transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
#final_combined = final_combined |> filter(Method != "Sai_Transfer")
# Compute the maximum MSE across Task columns for each combination of Method, n, similarity, and seed.
max_mse_data <- final_combined %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity, seed) %>%
  summarise(MaxMSE = mean(c_across(starts_with("Task")), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, 
                         levels = c("Baseline", 
                                    "Data Pooling",
                                    "Para_Transfer_Tuned", 
                                    "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned",
                                    "Sai_Transfer",
                                    "Net_Transfer",
                                    "ARMUL_transfer",
                                    "pERM_transfer")))

# For each group (Method, n, similarity), compute the whisker endpoints and filter out values outside.
# This "non_outlier_data" will be used only for setting the y-scale.
non_outlier_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    # Use a stricter threshold: coef = 1 (instead of the default 1.5)
    bp_stats <- boxplot.stats(.x$MaxMSE, coef = 1)$stats  
    lower <- bp_stats[1]
    upper <- bp_stats[5]
    .x %>% filter(MaxMSE >= lower, MaxMSE <= upper)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(Method, "Net_Transfer") ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL_transfer") ~ "ARMUL",
    str_detect(Method, "pERM_transfer") ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  filter(!Method %in% c( "Representation Transfer"))

non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  filter(!Method %in% c( "Representation Transfer"))
non_outlier_data$Method <- factor(non_outlier_data$Method,
                          levels = c("Baseline",
                                     "Data Pooling",
                                     "ARMUL",
                                     "pERM",
                                     #"Representation Transfer Learning",
                                     "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
                                     "Late Fusion",
                                     "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
                                     ))
# Now, plot the boxplot using the filtered (non-outlier) data so that the y-scale is not influenced by extremes.
CATE_Mean <- ggplot(non_outlier_data, aes(x = Method, y = MaxMSE, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2 , width = box_width) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Method",
    y = "Mean MSE",

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors
  ) +scale_y_log10()
CATE_Mean
```

```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)

big_font_theme <- theme(
  axis.title = element_text(size = 40),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 35),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 35),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 35),
  legend.title = element_blank()
)

p1 <- PLM_MSE +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = NULL)  + big_font_theme
  

p2 <- CATE_Mean +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, breaks = method_order, name = NULL) + big_font_theme
  

p3 <- DR_Mean +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, breaks = method_order) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, breaks = method_order, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.025, 0.3)) + big_font_theme
  


p1_leg <- p1 +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  )

legend <- get_legend(p1_leg)
p1_noleg <- p1 +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2)
  )

p3_noleg <- p3 +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2)
  )

p2_noleg <- p2 +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2)
  )
# combine three panels
top_row <- plot_grid(
  p1_noleg, p3_noleg, p2_noleg,
  ncol = 3,
  align = "hv",
  axis = "tblr",
  #rel_widths = c(1, 1, 1),
  labels = c("A", "B", "C"),
  label_size = 18
)

# first combine panels + legend
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  top_row,
  legend,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.08)
)
combined_plot <- ggdraw(combined_plot) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(80, 60, 80, 60))


combined_plot

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, "MSE_combined_plot.pdf"),
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 25,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
files

prepare_data_ <- function(result, file_name) {
  # Define methods to analyze
  methods <- c("Baseline", "Sai_Transfer", "Para_Transfer_Tuned", "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned", "Net_Transfer", "ARMUL_transfer", "pERM_Transfer", "Pooled")

  # Generate quantile data for each method
  quantiles_list <- lapply(methods, function(m) {
    quantile_df <- apply(result[result$method == m, "max_value", drop = FALSE], 2, function(col) {
      quantile(col, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
    })
    colnames(quantile_df) <- m
    quantile_df
  })

  # Combine quantile data and reshape it to long format
  quantiles <- do.call(cbind, quantiles_list)
  quantiles_long <- melt(quantiles, variable.name = "Method", value.name = "Value")
  
  # Add a column with the file name for faceting
  quantiles_long$Dataset <- basename(file_name)
  
  return(quantiles_long)
}

all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(file) {
  result <- load(file)  # Load the RData file (assumes it loads 'result' variable)\
  result <- get(result)
  prepare_data_(result, file)
}))
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract 'n' (e.g., 200 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    n = as.numeric(gsub(".*_n_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", Dataset)),
    
    # Extract 'similarity' (e.g., 0.4 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    similarity = as.numeric(gsub(".*_simi_(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?).*", "\\1", Dataset))
  )
all_data <- all_data %>%
  rename(Method = Var2) |> filter(n!=500)
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(Method, "Net_Transfer") ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL_transfer") ~ "ARMUL",
    str_detect(Method, "pERM_Transfer") ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
    

  ))

custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),  # Format 'n' as "n = ..."
  similarity = function(value) paste0("", value)  # Format 'similarity' as "similarity = ..."
)

# Plot with customized facet labels
plot <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
```

# Task-specific PLM figures

The saved data also contain every task-level MSE used by the additional plots
in the analysis script.

```{r plm-task-specific-figures, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
display_method <- function(method) {
  case_when(
    str_detect(method, regex("^Baseline", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(method, regex("^Pooled|^Data Pooling", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Data Pooling",
    str_detect(method, regex("^Sai_Transfer|Oracle Trans", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(method, regex("^NonPara_Transfer|Late Fusion with Nuisance", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(method, regex("^Para_Transfer|^Late Fusion$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(method, regex("^Net_Transfer|Representation Transfer", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(method, regex("^pERM", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(method, regex("^ARMUL", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "ARMUL",
    TRUE ~ as.character(method)
  )
}

plm_task_quantiles <- plm_results %>%
  select(method, n, similarity, all_of(paste0("task", 1:5))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(paste0("task", 1:5)),
    names_to = "Task",
    values_to = "MSE"
  ) %>%
  filter(n %in% c(100, 200), similarity %in% similarity_list) %>%
  group_by(method, n, similarity, Task) %>%
  summarise(
    Value = list(quantile(MSE, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest_longer(Value) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(display_method(method), levels = method_order),
    Task = factor(Task, levels = paste0("task", 1:5))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Method), is.finite(Value), Value > 0)

PLM_MSE_plots <- setNames(vector("list", 5), paste0("task", 1:5))
for (task_name in names(PLM_MSE_plots)) {
  task_plot <- ggplot(
    filter(plm_task_quantiles, Task == task_name),
    aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2, width = box_width) +
    facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Method", y = "MSE") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors, breaks = method_order, drop = FALSE)

  PLM_MSE_plots[[task_name]] <- task_plot
  print(task_plot)
  ggsave(
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0("PLM_MSE_", task_name, ".pdf")),
    task_plot,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

# Task-level comparison figures

```{r task-level-comparison, fig.width=18, fig.height=10}
prepare_task_comparison_data <- function(data, model_name) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  names(data) <- tolower(names(data))
  data %>%
    mutate(
      method = as.character(method),
      n = as.numeric(n),
      similarity = as.numeric(similarity)
    ) %>%
    select(method, n, similarity, any_of("seed"), task1, task4, task5) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(task1, task4, task5),
      names_to = "Task",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name, Method = display_method(method))
}

all_task_data <- bind_rows(
  prepare_task_comparison_data(plm_results, "PLM"),
  prepare_task_comparison_data(cate_results, "CATE") %>%
    filter(Method != "Representation Transfer"),
  prepare_task_comparison_data(dr_results, "DR")
) %>%
  filter(
    n %in% c(100, 200),
    similarity %in% main_similarity_list,
    is.finite(Value),
    Value > 0,
    Method %in% method_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = method_order),
    Task = factor(
      Task,
      levels = c("task1", "task4", "task5"),
      labels = c("Task 1", "Task 4", "Task 5")
    ),
    similarity = factor(
      similarity,
      levels = main_similarity_list,
      labels = format(main_similarity_list, trim = TRUE)
    ),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = c("PLM", "CATE", "DR"))
  )

all_task_data_no_outliers <- all_task_data %>%
  group_by(Model, n, Task, similarity, Method) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    valid_values <- .x$Value[is.finite(.x$Value) & .x$Value > 0]
    if (length(valid_values) < 2L) return(.x)
    whiskers <- boxplot.stats(valid_values, coef = 1.5)$stats
    filter(.x, Value >= whiskers[1], Value <= whiskers[5])
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

make_model_task_plot <- function(data, model_name) {
  ggplot(
    filter(data, Model == model_name),
    aes(
      x = similarity,
      y = Value,
      fill = Method,
      group = interaction(similarity, Method)
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      coef = 1.5,
      width = 0.75,
      position = position_dodge2(width = 0.90, preserve = "single", padding = 0.03)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      vars(n, Task),
      ncol = 3,
      scales = "free_y",
      labeller = labeller(
        n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),
        Task = label_value
      )
    ) +
    labs(x = "Similarity", y = "MSE", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.8, "lines")
    ) +
    scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.12))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors, breaks = method_order, drop = FALSE) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
}

task_comparison_plots <- lapply(
  c("PLM", "CATE", "DR"),
  function(model_name) make_model_task_plot(all_task_data_no_outliers, model_name)
)
names(task_comparison_plots) <- c("PLM", "CATE", "DR")

large_plot_theme <- theme(
  axis.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.title = element_blank(),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
  panel.spacing = grid::unit(1, "lines"),
  plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
)

for (model_name in names(task_comparison_plots)) {
  without_legend <- task_comparison_plots[[model_name]] +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  with_legend <- task_comparison_plots[[model_name]] +
    large_plot_theme +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

  print(with_legend)
  ggsave(
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0(model_name, "_Task_Comparison.pdf")),
    without_legend,
    width = 18,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0(model_name, "_Task_Comparison_with_legend.pdf")),
    with_legend,
    width = 18,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

# Task-level negative-transfer figures

```{r task-level-negative-transfer-all-methods, fig.width=18, fig.height=9}
library(scales)

negative_transfer_dir <- file.path(derived_dir, "negative_transfer")
dir.create(negative_transfer_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sample_sizes_to_plot <- c(100, 200)
similarities_to_plot <- similarity_list
method_order_negative_transfer <- c(
  "Data Pooling",
  "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
  "pERM",
  "Representation Transfer",
  "ARMUL",
  "Late Fusion",
  "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
)

prepare_negative_transfer_data <- function(data, model_name) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  names(data) <- tolower(names(data))
  task_columns <- names(data)[str_detect(names(data), "^task[0-9]+$")]
  missing_columns <- setdiff(c("method", "n", "similarity", "seed"), names(data))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L || length(task_columns) == 0L) {
    stop(model_name, " data do not contain the required task-level fields.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  data %>%
    mutate(
      method = as.character(method),
      seed = as.character(seed),
      n = as.numeric(n),
      similarity = as.numeric(similarity)
    ) %>%
    select(method, n, similarity, seed, all_of(task_columns)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(task_columns),
      names_to = "Task",
      values_to = "MSE"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_name, Method = display_method(method)) %>%
    filter(Method %in% c("Baseline", method_order_negative_transfer), is.finite(MSE))
}

all_negative_transfer_long <- bind_rows(
  prepare_negative_transfer_data(plm_results, "PLM"),
  prepare_negative_transfer_data(cate_results, "SATE"),
  prepare_negative_transfer_data(dr_results, "DR")
) %>%
  filter(
    n %in% sample_sizes_to_plot,
    round(similarity, 8) %in% round(similarities_to_plot, 8)
  )

negative_transfer_seed_level <- all_negative_transfer_long %>%
  group_by(Model, n, similarity, seed, Task, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    MSE = mean(MSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    Number_of_rows = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

duplicated_seed_results <- filter(negative_transfer_seed_level, Number_of_rows > 1L)
if (nrow(duplicated_seed_results) > 0L) {
  warning(
    nrow(duplicated_seed_results),
    " method/seed/task combinations contained duplicate rows; their MSE values were averaged."
  )
}
negative_transfer_seed_level <- select(negative_transfer_seed_level, -Number_of_rows)

baseline_seed_level <- negative_transfer_seed_level %>%
  filter(Method == "Baseline") %>%
  select(Model, n, similarity, seed, Task, Baseline_MSE = MSE)

negative_transfer_paired <- negative_transfer_seed_level %>%
  filter(Method != "Baseline") %>%
  inner_join(
    baseline_seed_level,
    by = c("Model", "n", "similarity", "seed", "Task")
  ) %>%
  rename(Method_MSE = MSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Worse_than_baseline = Method_MSE > Baseline_MSE,
    MSE_difference = Method_MSE - Baseline_MSE,
    Relative_MSE_change = if_else(
      Baseline_MSE > 0,
      (Method_MSE - Baseline_MSE) / Baseline_MSE,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

negative_transfer_rate <- negative_transfer_paired %>%
  group_by(Model, n, similarity, Task, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_repetitions = n(),
    Number_worse = sum(Worse_than_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    Negative_transfer_rate = mean(Worse_than_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_MSE_difference = mean(MSE_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_MSE_difference = median(MSE_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_relative_MSE_change = mean(Relative_MSE_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Task = factor(Task, levels = paste0("task", 1:5), labels = paste("Task", 1:5)),
    Method = factor(Method, levels = method_order_negative_transfer),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = c("PLM", "SATE", "DR"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Model, n, Task, Method, similarity)

negative_transfer_colors <- colors[method_order_negative_transfer]
negative_transfer_linetypes <- c(
  "Data Pooling" = "solid",
  "Oracle Trans-Lasso" = "dashed",
  "pERM" = "dotted",
  "Representation Transfer" = "dotdash",
  "ARMUL" = "longdash",
  "Late Fusion" = "twodash",
  "Late Fusion with Nuisance" = "solid"
)
negative_transfer_shapes <- c(
  "Data Pooling" = 15,
  "Oracle Trans-Lasso" = 16,
  "pERM" = 17,
  "Representation Transfer" = 18,
  "ARMUL" = 3,
  "Late Fusion" = 7,
  "Late Fusion with Nuisance" = 8
)

make_negative_transfer_plot <- function(result_data, model_name, large = FALSE) {
  model_data <- filter(result_data, Model == model_name, !is.na(Method)) %>% droplevels()
  if (nrow(model_data) == 0L) {
    stop("No negative-transfer results were found for ", model_name, call. = FALSE)
  }

  plot <- ggplot(
    model_data,
    aes(
      x = similarity,
      y = Negative_transfer_rate,
      color = Method,
      linetype = Method,
      shape = Method,
      group = Method
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "grey60", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(linewidth = if (large) 1.25 else 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = if (large) 4 else 2.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_grid(n ~ Task, labeller = labeller(n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = similarities_to_plot) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = negative_transfer_colors, breaks = method_order_negative_transfer) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = negative_transfer_linetypes, breaks = method_order_negative_transfer) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = negative_transfer_shapes, breaks = method_order_negative_transfer) +
    labs(
      x = "Similarity",
      y = "Proportion worse than baseline",
      color = NULL,
      linetype = NULL,
      shape = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = if (large) 22 else 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      strip.text = element_text(size = if (large) 22 else 10, face = if (large) "bold" else "plain"),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(if (large) 1.1 else 0.8, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
      linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
      shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    )
  plot
}

negative_transfer_plots <- lapply(
  c("PLM", "SATE", "DR"),
  function(model_name) make_negative_transfer_plot(negative_transfer_rate, model_name)
)
names(negative_transfer_plots) <- c("PLM", "SATE", "DR")

write.csv(
  negative_transfer_rate,
  file.path(negative_transfer_dir, "task_level_negative_transfer_rates_all_methods.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  negative_transfer_paired,
  file.path(negative_transfer_dir, "task_level_negative_transfer_seed_level_all_methods.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

for (model_name in names(negative_transfer_plots)) {
  print(negative_transfer_plots[[model_name]])
  write.csv(
    filter(negative_transfer_rate, Model == model_name),
    file.path(negative_transfer_dir, paste0(model_name, "_task_level_negative_transfer_rates.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0(model_name, "_task_level_negative_transfer_all_methods.pdf")),
    negative_transfer_plots[[model_name]],
    width = 18,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```
